title: 叩长安 v6 妻子视角
prompt: Female Chinese folk ballad, 74BPM, D minor pentatonic, 4/4. Style mix: narrative smoothness of 三国恋 plus restrained tragedy of 赤伶. Third-person wife watching her husband at night under a lamp, tender pity, silent heartache, one continuous scene, no genre jumps. Female vocal only, warm, close, low in verses like she is looking at him and dare not speak; chorus is female 戏腔悲叹, tearful light sigh, NOT high belt, NOT explosion, NOT shouting. NO spoken word, NO talking, NO rap, NO male voice. The inner-monologue lines must still be SUNG as breathy pitched 气声, never spoken. Arrangement rebuilt: Verse = soft guzheng arpeggio, very weak xiao long tones, sparse wooden fish, sub pad; mute pipa, big drum, suona, erhu. Then 8-bar guzheng interlude, all drums stop, only guzheng plus sparse xiao, extreme silence, she stares. Pre-chorus: xiao rises, light rim roll, weak bass. 4-bar pipa with soft melancholy, last bar total rest. Chorus: erhu enters wrapping the vocal, guzheng arpeggios, soft drums, no heavy kick, no suona. Bridge: slightly more tension, light downbeat drum only, tiny suona atmosphere, no war-drum blast. Outro: all tension instruments fade, return to guzheng xiao pad, bittersweet close. Emotions layer slowly: gaze, ache, empathy, staying. Real human female vocal, in tune, lingering, cinematic, tears in throat. No EDM, no trap, no idol brightness, no sudden rock climax.
lyrics:
[Intro]
(古筝与弱箫，女声气声轻叹)
嗯……

[Verse 1]
灯影摇落旧章
岁岁陪他孤坐至天光
寒途只身前往
一腔热忱 从未肯退让
无数朝夕俯仰
满心期许 皆付与渺茫
旁人不识怅惘
唯她看清 他眼底跌宕

[Interlude]
(古筝八小节，全鼓静音，箫零星呼应，极致留白)

[Pre-Chorus]
几番奔赴闯荡
几番云雾遮断远方
明明倾尽热肠
偏偏命运 不肯相谅
未敢轻言离场
只是心力 早已沧桑
一腔少年坦荡
困于尘俗 无人相赏

[Interlude]
(琵琶轻轮指柔怅上行，末小节全休止)

[Chorus]
雾色漫过层台
半生求索 困于尘埃
一腔孤勇深埋
世俗从来 只论成败
霜色铺满长阶
只身起落 无人关怀
纵是万般落败
心底星火 未曾沉埋

[Bridge]
世人皆看结果
唯有我见过他一路跌撞的模样
笔墨空负年少华章
锋芒沉于人海寻常
众生皆逐名利过往
谁惜凡人 寸寸热肠
纵然难登云外高堂
初心未向世事投降
纵被人间风雨磨伤
一身澄澈 未曾消亡

[Outro]
夜色归于静凉
旧年意气 心底珍藏
纵无高远风光
不负当初 年少热望
她看尽他跌宕
万般平凡 亦是坦荡
初心从未虚妄
温柔相守 岁岁如常
[End]
